field_changes.old:
The following routes now have badges and XP available for runners: Flat Route Run, Loop de Loop Run, Volcano Flat Run, and Beach Island Loop Run.
New wheels are available in the Drop Shop: Shimano C36, Shimano C50, Shimano C60, and Shimano C99.
Zwifters can now deselect all screenshots at the end of an activity.
Route sorting preferences are now saved between sessions and shared between cycling and running modes.
field_changes.new:
Cycling routes from the Makuri Madness ZRacing series are now available for free rides, meetups, clubs, and events.
Select running routes now have achievement badges and completion XP available.
Select event-only routes now have achievement badges and completion XP available.
Route completion badges are now awarded after teleporting to a friend or RoboPacer and completing a full route lap from the official start of the route.
